events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music and Art Fair took place from August 15 to 18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Woodstock Festival, three days of peace and music that defined a generation. Which artists would you have loved to see live?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Elvis Presley. His music continues to shake, rattle, and roll generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas and died six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering the influential artist Tupac Shakur, whose powerful lyrics and impact on hip-hop culture continue to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Today we pay tribute to the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, a true pioneer whose guitar wizardry changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album changed the game when it dropped. What's your go-to track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the rock icon Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and attitude are timeless.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' by John Lennon is a message that still resonates today. What does this iconic track mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got an iPod? Today marks the anniversary of its launch, changing how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Masterpiece
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped on this day, a sprawling and experimental masterpiece. What are your hidden gems from this iconic record?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the incredible legacy of Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and music are simply unforgettable.
